text.A: **無論你身在何處，本政策均適用。** 本公司遵循英國資料保護法；如你居住國家的資料保護法亦適用，本公司亦遵循該法。
text.B: **過敏及飲食備註。** 本公司會將其連同你的訂單傳送給餐車，且不會將其用於任何其他用途。本公司會於訂單成立 12 個月後，將這些備註連同你的姓名及聯絡資料一併刪除（見第 7 節）。
text.C: **國際傳輸。** 你的帳號資料及訂單資料均在英國儲存及處理。部分事項於英國境外處理：菜單擷取及 WhatsApp 自動回覆，使用位於美國的 Google 服務；WhatsApp 訊息傳遞，由位於美國的 Meta 處理；付款，由位於美國的 Stripe 處理；推播通知，由位於美國的 Apple 及 Google 傳送。資料傳輸至英國境外時，該傳輸受英國適足性規則（UK adequacy regulations），或國際資料傳輸協議（International Data Transfer Agreement）或其增補條款（Addendum）所涵蓋；你所在國家的法律有此要求時，並受該法律所認可的保護措施所涵蓋。你可要求本公司提供所適用保護措施的詳細資訊。
text.D:
## 8. 你的權利

依英國資料保護法，以及於適用時你居住國家的法律，你有權：

- 查詢本公司持有之你的個人資料，並取得其複本；
- 請求更正不正確的資料；
- 於特定情況下，請求刪除你的資料；
- 於特定情況下，限制本公司利用你的資料；
- 以可攜格式取得你的資料；
- 對基於正當利益所為之處理提出異議；
- 於本公司以同意為依據時，隨時撤回同意。

你居住地的法律可能以其他名稱賦予你上述權利，或賦予你額外的權利。你同樣享有這些權利。

**提出請求。** 請寄送電子郵件至 privacy@hatchgrab.com。本公司會在處理前確認請求的真實性。你可以委託他人代為提出請求，且本公司不會因你提出請求而給予你差別待遇。本公司將於一個月內回覆；你所在國家的法律有此要求時，將更早回覆。你曾向餐車點餐時，本公司可能將你的請求轉交該餐車，因為該餐車決定你的訂單資料如何使用。本公司拒絕請求時，你可以回覆本公司的答覆，要求本公司重新審查。

**刪除你的帳號。** 業者可在應用程式內，或寄送電子郵件至 privacy@hatchgrab.com，請求刪除帳號。本公司將刪除你的帳號及個人資料，但本公司因會計或法律原因而須保存紀錄者，不在此限。業者的帳號遭刪除時，本公司亦會從本公司保存的訂單中，刪除其顧客的姓名、聯絡資料及備註。

**行銷電子郵件。** 本公司僅在你居住地的法律允許的情況下寄送行銷電子郵件；在部分國家，這表示僅在取得你的同意後寄送。每一封行銷電子郵件都會載明寄件者、載有本公司的郵寄地址，並告訴你如何停止接收。你要求本公司停止寄送時，本公司將免費並於 10 個工作天內停止。關於訂單或你的帳號的電子郵件不屬於行銷郵件。本公司或餐車提供以簡訊通知訂單進度時，你僅在同意後才會收到，且你可以隨時停止接收。

**發生問題時。** 涉及你個人資料的外洩事件很可能對你造成嚴重損害時，於法律有所要求的情況下，本公司將儘速通知你及主管機關，或協助你點餐的餐車進行通知。

**申訴。** 請先寄送電子郵件至 privacy@hatchgrab.com 告知本公司；本公司希望能有機會改正問題。你亦可向你居住地的資料保護主管機關提出申訴。在英國，主管機關為英國資訊專員辦公室（Information Commissioner's Office），網址為 ico.org.uk，電話為 0303 123 1113。

back.A: **Wherever you are, this policy applies.** We follow UK data protection law; where the data protection law of the country you live in also applies, we follow that law too.
back.B: **Allergy and dietary notes.** We pass them, together with your order, to the food truck, and do not use them for any other purpose. 12 months after the order was placed, we delete these notes together with your name and contact details (see section 7).
back.C: Where data is transferred outside the UK, the transfer is covered by the UK adequacy regulations, or by the International Data Transfer Agreement or its Addendum; where the law of your country requires it, it is also covered by a safeguard recognised by that law.
back.D: ## 8. Your rights / Under UK data protection law and, where applicable, the law of the country you live in, you have the right to: [7 bullets unchanged] / The law where you live may give you these rights under other names, or give you extra rights. You have those rights as well. / **Making a request.** Please send an email to privacy@hatchgrab.com. We will confirm the request is genuine before handling it. You can have someone else make the request on your behalf, and we will not treat you differently because you made a request. We will reply within one month; where the law of your country requires it, we will reply sooner. If you ordered from a food truck, we may pass your request to that food truck, because that food truck decides how your order details are used. If we refuse a request, you can reply to our answer and ask us to review it again. / **Deleting your account.** [old text unchanged] When an operator's account is deleted, we also delete its customers' names, contact details and notes from the orders we keep. / **Marketing emails.** We send marketing emails only where the law where you live allows it; in some countries this means only after obtaining your consent. Every marketing email states the sender, contains our postal address and tells you how to stop receiving them. If you ask us to stop, we will stop free of charge and within 10 working days. Emails about an order or your account are not marketing emails. If we or a food truck offer order-progress notices by text message, you will only receive them after you agree, and you can stop receiving them at any time. / **When a problem occurs.** If a leak involving your personal data is likely to cause you serious harm, where the law so requires, we will notify you and the competent authority as soon as possible, or help the food truck you ordered from to notify. / **Complaints.** Please first email privacy@hatchgrab.com to tell us; we hope to have the chance to put things right. You can also complain to the data protection authority where you live. In the UK the authority is the UK Information Commissioner's Office (Information Commissioner's Office), website ico.org.uk, telephone 0303 123 1113.
